summary: Phase D-6 (verification scoring + fraud flags), D-7 (passport score card UI), and D-8 (AI valuation) verified end-to-end on deployed environment. Backend: 14/14 D-6/D-8 tests pass; D-4 + D-5 regression 27/27 still pass. All 4 spot-check curls (score, valuation, admin fraud flags, admin recompute-score) return expected shapes. Frontend passport for AMASS-LAG-00000233 renders the new PropertyScoreCard between the title block and the About/Listings/History tabs, showing: tier chip (UNVERIFIED gray), radial SVG score gauge (5/100), AI Value Estimate strip with graceful fallback ('Not enough comparables yet…'), and chevron expansion revealing all six breakdown factors (recency, gps_tier, drift, photo, agent_trust, duplicate_cleanliness). No red-screen or crash observed. Component degrades gracefully when valuation returns no comparables and/or Claude narrative is absent. No blocking issues found.

react_native_issues.issue: No testID attributes on the tier pill, gauge, value strip, chevron pressable, or breakdown rows. This works today but blocks robust automated UI testing — had to click by pixel coordinates to expand the card. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/PropertyScoreCard.tsx

action_items: (nice-to-have) Add testIDs to PropertyScoreCard sub-elements (e.g. score-card-root, tier-pill, score-gauge-num, ai-value-amount, ai-value-fallback, expand-chevron, breakdown-<factor>) so future UI regression tests can assert them deterministically without pixel-coordinate clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyScoreCard uses Promise.allSettled correctly so passport still renders if either endpoint fails — verified: legacy AMASS-LAG-00000233 has no comparables and the valuation strip degrades to the fallback copy without breaking layout.
Score endpoint payload shape matches spec exactly: amass_property_id, score, tier, breakdown, computed_at, verified_at, location_verification_status.

Admin fraud flags endpoint returns items + count + counts_by_type as documented (live env shows 34 active flags across MISSING_PROOF_PHOTO, HIGH_GPS_DRIFT, LOW_GPS_ACCURACY_SET, CLUSTER_DUPLICATE — good signal the D-5 verify hook is firing).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (passport renders + score card + gauge + fallback + expansion breakdown all verified)

seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-existing legacy AMASS-LAG-00000233 property as requested; pytest suite seeds its own candidates through /api/admin/discovery.
